result.finding: Cross-platform (Linux/macOS/Windows) — the Spring Boot Java application is OS-agnostic and runs on any JVM-supported OS. No OS-specific deployment configuration exists. The Oracle XE Docker image referenced in the README uses Linux containers.
evidence: No Dockerfile found — no base image OS to determine
No Kubernetes nodeSelector or OS affinity configured
No .NET RuntimeIdentifier — application is Java (cross-platform JVM)
Application uses Java 17 (cross-platform) with Spring Boot 3.2.4 (cross-platform)
README.md documents Docker usage (Linux containers) for Oracle XE dependency
No OS-specific shell scripts (.sh or .bat) found in project
README.md setup commands use bash syntax (curl, mvn) — compatible with Linux/macOS
values: Development/host OS: Cross-platform (Linux, macOS, Windows all supported by JVM)
JVM requirement: Java 17 or higher (per README.md)
